title: Grai Darki
description: Tell Grai Darki was the site of a Hellenistic and Roman settlement. The site is located approximately 2 km north of Tell Deir Situn. John Curtis conducted excavations here as part of the Saddam Dam Salvage Project.

properties.description: Representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
